name: qh-swelite-requests-pytest-compat-01
command: set -e; python -B -m pip install --no-index --no-deps --find-links /opt/compat pytest==4.6.11 pluggy==0.13.1 atomicwrites==1.4.1 py==1.11.0 six==1.17.0 attrs==23.2.0 more-itertools==9.1.0 packaging==24.2 wcwidth==0.2.13; python -B -m pytest -p no:cacheprovider -q test_requests.py::RequestsTestCase::test_conflicting_post_params; set +e; python -B -m pytest -p no:cacheprovider -q /tmp/test_control.py; control_exit=$?; echo deliberate_control_exit=$control_exit; test "$control_exit" -eq 1
